config_fields.name: redirect_uri
config_fields.help: The callback URL registered for your BASE Developers app; BASE requires it in every refresh-token request ('redirect_uri 登録したコールバックURL (必須)', https://docs.thebase.in/api/oauth/refresh_token).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of your app at https://developers.thebase.in/ (API application required).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret of the same app.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from the one-time authorization-code exchange (GET /1/oauth/authorize with scope read_users read_items read_orders → POST /1/oauth/token, https://docs.thebase.in/api/oauth/access_token). Valid about 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the rotated token survives restarts.

me.note: The connected shop: {user: {shop_id, shop_name, shop_url, …}} (scope read_users).

list_products.note: Items of the CONNECTED BASE SHOP (GET /1/items, scope read_items), in list_order; `category` is a BASE category_id. BASE is a storefront platform, so these are the merchant's own products, not a supplier catalogue; keyword search is not applied (GET /1/items/search needs its own q).

get_product.note: One item of the connected shop (GET /1/items/detail/:item_id); variations[{variation_id, variation, variation_stock, variation_identifier}] are in `raw`.

get_order.note: An order received by the connected shop (GET /1/orders/detail/:unique_key, scope read_orders). dispatch_status: unshippable, ordered (未対応), unpaid, shipping, dispatched, cancelled; `created_at` is epoch seconds; order_items and order_receiver are in `raw`.

not_offered.quote_shipping: BASE is the merchant's own storefront; the API index (https://docs.thebase.in/api/) has Users, Items, Categories, Orders, Savings, Delivery Company and Search endpoints and no shipping-rate calculation.
not_offered.create_order: Orders are placed by shoppers on the storefront; the API offers only 'GET /1/orders', 'GET /1/orders/detail/:unique_key' and 'POST /1/orders/edit_status' (https://docs.thebase.in/api/), no order creation.
not_offered.track: No shipment-tracking endpoint exists (https://docs.thebase.in/api/); the order's tracking_number and dispatch_status are returned by get_order.

adapter.terms: BASE API (https://docs.thebase.in/api/): application-reviewed developer apps, OAuth2 access tokens valid one hour, refresh tokens about 30 days and rotated on refresh; 5,000 calls per hour and 100,000 per day per user ('APIの利用制限').

evidence: probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
